project recordsQuality control comment August 2023 This values of 2326 605 female and 1721 male has been set to 0. Final report. The value of 12284 corresponds to 5 contributions to EURF 2.15 814 954 8048 2326 105 In all of them the EURF indicator was encoded as a logframe indicator and there arent comments in OPSYS to clarify to what it corresponds to the justification of the match and any calculations involved. From the narrative of the report is also unclear to know if there is double counting amongst the individuals reported under the different values. It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.

The value of 12284 corresponds to 5 contributions to EURF 2.15 814 954 8048 2326 105 In all of them the EURF indicator was encoded as a logframe indicator and there arent comments in OPSYS to clarify to what it corresponds to the justification of the match and any calculations involved. From the narrative of the report is also unclear to know if there is double counting amongst the individuals reported under the different values. It is therefore decided to only report the highest value of all of them 8048 which corresponds to the number of youth registered and successfully completed skill development courses.

Average % of households receiving social protection

comment.narrative: Ethiopia according to the World Banks HighFrequency Phone Surveys on COVID19. Overall 16.7 percent of households received some form of assistance from the government nongovernment sources or both between March and October 2020. Tanzania In terms of social assistance the Productive Social Safety Net programme PSSN is the countrys main social assistance programme and it is implemented in Tanzania Mainland and in Zanzibar. It has enrolled more than 1 million poor and extremely poor households reflecting a coverage of about 10 of the population of Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar. Malawi and Zambia 21.3 and 24.6 of the population is covered by at least one social protection benefit in Malawi and Zambia respectively
Target 20 increase

Overall 16.7 percent of households received some form of assistance from the government nongovernment sources or both between March and October 2020. Tanzania In terms of social assistance the Productive Social Safety Net programme PSSN is the countrys main social assistance programme and it is implemented in Tanzania Mainland and in Zanzibar. It has enrolled more than 1 million poor and extremely poor households reflecting a coverage of about 10 of the population of Mainland Tanzania and Zanzibar.
